Crown depression removed; full low directional crown with continuous warm-ivory surface. Blue crown applique absent. User then challenged left/right consistency and preferred the earlier I2 crown mass to this broad slanted lid.

Straight-on front artwork restores fuller continuous crown volume without blue top applique, organizes matching paired shells and joint groups, and retains simplified end effectors. Major bilateral geometry visually corresponds; small rendering and detail differences remain. This is a raster front concept, not exact mirrored CAD or proof of sagittal Z articulation. No new modelling or experiment. User requested a less flat, more aggressive upper protector.

Raised central crown and stronger silhouette produced, but crown touched top frame and surface developed channel-like shading. Finishing edit followed; not current deliverable. User subsequently supplied seven regional simplification and continuous-surface corrections on this image.

user_feedback.request: Remove redundant small blue crown applique.
Simplify overlapping forearm armor into a single guard.
Make feet more practically grounded and less anime/comic.
Extra crown ridges undermine simplicity; do not substitute creases for sophisticated shape.
Make the structure itself more forceful without extra corners.

calls.notes: Full top outline now visible, with raised central crown and steeper paired side returns. Major bilateral assemblies, simple graspers/feet and three leg cover groups retained. Upper side highlight bands remain pronounced; aesthetic judgment pending. Front artwork is not proof of side geometry, exact CAD symmetry or engineering dimensions. Latest feedback on P also applies to inherited blue fins, layered armor and crown surface treatment.

Small crown blue fins removed, but ridged/channel-like crown shading, separate ivory inner forearm plate, lower-link blue side guards and boot-like foot volumes persisted. Targeted regional redraw followed.

Crown center strip and twin trough shading removed; one continuous ivory upper volume. Forearms have unified azure guards without separate ivory inner overplates. Lower moving links have clean single ivory guards without blue side fins; three leg groups and independent ankle remain visible. Foot volume reduced to low platform and modest ankle shield. Top margin is narrow. Aesthetic aggression and sagittal geometry remain pending; no computed topology optimization or engineering validation claimed. User then supplied paired upper-flank guard locations, rejected the feet, and identified excessive repetition of the middle/distal leg guards.

Paired broad navy guards frame the ivory upper core. Consecutive lower groups now differ: full ivory middle shank versus narrow graphite terminal carrier. Thin formed toe supports, visible ankle assembly and compact dark rear heels replace platform boots. Full three-link chain and simplified forearms retained. Crown margin remains narrow. Raster appearance only; side articulation, exact support geometry and manufacture remain unverified. User clarified permitted color is original blue or black, rejected unrequested navy, identified top-heavy balance and unchanged soft upper-guard arc.

calls.notes: Upper guards now use the existing bright azure family, matching shoulders/forearms. Long curved guard tails replaced by compact hard-edged upper pieces with a different perimeter. Graphite distal carriers, ankle supports and foot grounding broadened while middle/distal differentiation and extra fold remain. Ivory core continuity retained. Overall aesthetic balance remains for user review; no mass, CAD or dynamics inference. Subsequent user marks rejected spherical top, pointless fittings and upper yellow strip parts; requested wider low feet and coherent shank, then supplied contour guide.

Upper contour changed to a taut short top span, upper yellow-strip parts removed, feet broadened and incidental color accents removed. User rejected the removal of exterior color and failure to sufficiently reduce actual internal balls/columns. Forefoot sidewall remained bulky; followed by T2 local finishing.

Lowered the broad forefoot sidewalls and reduced extra foot-side caps; torso fitting clusters partly contained in graphite service housings. User identified continued flat top and unnecessary elbow, shoulder and waist parts, clarified color must be retained, then specified open graphite upper flank guards and surface depth. No approval.

Paired upper flank guards use the user-authorized graphite of the inner frame, with open undersides showing compact shoulder drives. Repeated elbow columns and shoulder ball/coil strings replaced by fewer integrated drive/frame members; waist/hip roots simplified. Saffron exterior accents restored as colored finish on existing shells. Main ivory top receives a continuous shaped depth/section treatment; broad low feet and differentiated lower links retained. Latest instruction concerns structural distribution, not increased total height. Visual concept only; no computed topology optimum, CAD measurement, physical stability or exact symmetry claim.
